landing.headline: Hire on evidence, not guesswork.
landing.subheadline: Caliber is a talent-intelligence platform: explainable shortlisting, adaptive AI screening, and an honest candidate agent — bias-safe and human-in-the-loop.
landing.systemTitle: One evidence chain from role brief to candidate agent.
landing.systemBody: Caliber keeps every critical hiring decision grounded: role specs become rubrics, rubrics become explainable shortlists, interviews probe the same evidence, and candidates only move with verified claims.
landing.feature1Body: Describe a role in plain language. Get a structured spec, a weighted rubric, and a ranked shortlist where every score traces back to evidence.
landing.feature2Body: An adaptive interviewer probes each competency and produces an evidence-tagged report card — no black box, no fabrication.
landing.feature3Body: It works while you sleep, applying only where your verified profile already qualifies you — never inventing a thing.
landing.closeTitle: Ready for the demo room and the real hiring floor.
landing.closeBody: Start with a role, a profile, or a screening path. Caliber keeps the story auditable from the first click.

auth.proofBody: Caliber links profile claims, interview scores, and agent actions back to source evidence so hiring teams and candidates can trust the path.
auth.signInPrompt: Step back into the evidence room: shortlists, screenings, radar, and candidate-agent activity in one place.
auth.passwordHint: Choose your workspace role and use a password of at least 12 characters.

notFound.heading: This page isn't in the evidence chain.
notFound.message: The route you asked for has no record on file — it may have moved, or it never existed. Every Caliber page traces back to a source; this one doesn't.
